task_description: Write a method in Dafny to find the sum of even numbers at even positions of an integer array.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method SumEvenNumbersAtEvenPositions(arr: array<int>) returns (sum: int)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The sum is the total of all even numbers located at positions with even indices (0-based) in the input array
- All elements at even positions in the input array that are even numbers are included in the sum
- Elements at odd positions are not included in the sum
